title: 第15章 小杂役不知深浅第16章 分配一个好活
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
考核全部结束时，太阳还没落山。
几艘巨大的灵舟缓缓降落在广场上。
有幸通过考核的将近两千弟子依次进入灵舟。
灵舟是大宗门才有的灵器，是常用的交通工具，用灵石作为动力。
凌霄城距离凌霄宗还有三万多里，用灵舟方便快捷。
在楚如玉的一再恳请下，长老允许落尘和李富贵也坐上了第一艘灵舟。
这艘灵舟设施很豪华，里面的二百人，除了落尘和李富贵，都是内门的新弟子。
不少人都知道落尘灵根杂的不能再杂，是靠妹妹的关系才勉强能当个杂役。
如今又靠着妹妹的关系和他们同乘豪华灵舟，看向落尘的眼神很不屑。
一些人跃跃欲试想找麻烦，但顾忌楚如玉在场，没有行动。
极品灵根者前程无限，面子还是要给的。
落尘丝毫不在意那些鄙视和挑衅的眼神，笑眯眯地吃着灵舟上提供的点心。
点心用上了一些灵药，有少许灵气，吃了有助于修炼。
“真好吃，吃的我肚子里面热乎乎的。”
李富贵拍着肚皮，一脸满足。
“嗯，我身上都热乎乎的，这点心吃了一块都不怕冷了。”
楚如玉满足地舔舔嘴唇。
“好吃，你们就多吃点。”
落尘把邻桌没动的点心，端到了楚如玉和李富贵面前。
不知为什么，他吃了一点反应没有。

但楚如玉和李富贵吃了有作用，多多益善。
“土豹子，乡巴佬。”
“什么人都有，还有跑这蹭吃蹭喝的。”
“一个小杂役还不知深浅。”
邻桌的人不满地嘀咕道。
楚如玉脸红了。
李富贵脸色变得不善，眼神凌厉起来。
落尘好像没听到议论，吃完一块点心，抹抹嘴道：
“吃，吃，多吃点。
以后，你俩一个在内门，一个在外面，一定好好修炼。
能不惹事就不惹事。
但绝不能怕事，谁欺负你们了告诉我。”
李富贵点点头。
“嗯，哥你最厉害了。”
楚如玉搂着落尘的胳膊，小脸靠在落尘肩上。
远处包间里，一位紫衣女子注意到落尘和楚如玉亲密的一幕，皱皱了眉头。
她叫于晴，宗门的三长老。
看样子不到四十岁，肤白貌美，风韵犹存。
刚刚听说出现了一个极品火灵根，她特意赶来考察，有意收为亲传弟子。
content_en:
When all the assessments were over, the sun had not yet set.
Several huge spiritual boats slowly landed on the square.
Nearly two thousand disciples who were lucky enough to pass the assessment entered the spirit boat one after another.
The spirit boat is a spiritual weapon that only exists in large sects. It is a commonly used means of transportation and uses spirit stones as power.
Lingxiao City is still more than 30,000 miles away from Lingxiao Sect, so it is convenient and quick to use the spirit boat.
Under Chu Ruyu's repeated pleas, the elder allowed Luochen and Li Fugui to board the first spiritual boat.
The facilities of this spiritual boat are very luxurious, and the two hundred people inside, except Luochen and Li Fugui, are all new disciples of the inner sect.
Many people know that Luochen's spiritual roots are extremely complicated, and it is only through his relationship with his younger sister that he can barely be a handyman.
Now, relying on his sister's relationship, he rides on the luxurious spiritual boat with them, looking at Luochen with disdain.
Some people were eager to cause trouble, but did not take any action due to Chu Ruyu's presence.
Those with the best spiritual roots have unlimited future, but they still have to give face.
Luochen didn't care at all about the disdainful and provocative looks, and ate the snacks provided on the spirit boat with a smile.
Some elixirs are used in the snacks, which have a little spiritual energy. Eating them will help you practice.
"It's so delicious. My stomach feels warm after eating it."
Li Fugui patted his belly with a satisfied look on his face.
"Well, I'm feeling warm all over. I won't be afraid of the cold after eating one piece of this snack."
Chu Ruyu licked her lips with satisfaction.
"It's delicious, just eat more."
Luochen brought the untouched snacks from the next table to Chu Ruyu and Li Fugui.
For some reason, he had no reaction after eating it.
But Chu Ruyu and Li Fugui take it and it has an effect, the more the better.
"Country leopard, country bumpkin."
"There are everyone here, including people who come here to eat and drink."
"A little handyman doesn't know the depth yet."
The people at the next table murmured dissatisfiedly.
Chu Ruyu blushed.
Li Fugui's face turned unkind and his eyes became sharp.
Luochen didn't seem to hear the discussion. After finishing a piece of snack, he wiped his mouth and said:
“Eat, eat, eat more.
From now on, one of you will be in the inner sect and the other will be in the outer sect. You must practice hard.
If you can avoid causing trouble, don't cause trouble.
But you must not be afraid of trouble. If anyone bullies you, tell me. "
Li Fugui nodded.
"Well, brother, you are the best."
Chu Ruyu hugged Luochen's arm and rested her face on Luochen's shoulder.
In a private room far away, a woman in purple noticed the intimate scene between Luochen and Chu Ruyu and frowned.
Her name is Yu Qing, the third elder of the sect.
He looked to be less than forty years old, with fair skin, good looks, and still charming charm.
She had just heard that a top-quality fire spirit root had appeared, and she came here specially to investigate, intending to accept him as her personal disciple.
